rows.note: Use 從來 as the all-purpose Cantonese adverb for something that has never happened or is never done.

example.jyutping: ngo5 cung4 loi4 m4 sik6 laat6 je5

rows.note: Use 從未 for saying that something has not happened at any time up to the relevant past point, especially in more formal or written language.

example.english: Until I left the job, I had never been late.
example.traditional: 直到我離職，我從未遲到。
example.jyutping: zik6 dou3 ngo5 lei4 zik1 ngo5 cung4 mei6 ci4 dou3
